caption: The drawing depicts a single large knife with a straight back and a sharply angled, slanted point at the tip. The blade is long, rectangular, and appears worn with a mix of brownish-red coloration, likely representing rust or staining, and some whitish patches along the edge. The handle is wooden, colored light brown, and is attached to the blade with three visible round rivets. The knife is positioned horizontally in the center of the image against a plain beige background. At the bottom center of the image, there is a small area of text that includes the name "Walter Jon Braecke" and the year "1939".
title: Corn Knife
